the squaring procedure for the primary constraints in the generalized Hamiltonian dynamics does not lead to the same model of the relativisic particle with curvature and torson in the three-dimensional spacetime as the one that was used as the starting point for the analysis.

the squaring the primary Hamiltonian constraints leads in the case of the model of a relativistic particle with non-zero torsion and curvature in the three-dimensional spacetime to a wrong result, and that the correct result can be obtained only by the squaring of all the Hamiltonian constraints.
